source.title: Signal Processing Meets SGD: From Momentum to Filter
source.authors: Zhi-Peng Yao; Rui-Long Yu; Gui-Song Chang; Ying Li; Yu Zhang; Dazhou Li

record.file_problem: The supplied text contains the full paper and appendices; some figure content is flattened, but the relevant CIFAR optimizer accuracies are in a table.
record.tranche_reason: Compares optimizers on held-out accuracy under a different experimental setup from the claim’s cited optimizer studies.
record.gate_note: The CIFAR optimizer table reports test accuracies for individual optimizers against SGD. Hessian and loss-landscape results do not measure the magnitude-aware perturbation metric in V7. The cited prior-work claims are not this study’s results.
record.test_reason: The study directly compares adaptive optimizers with momentum SGD using held-out image-classification accuracy, the same basic method and measure as V4's original optimizer comparisons. Its tuning also includes momentum coefficients and AdamW weight decay, so it does not isolate V4's restricted-tuning condition.
record.authors_conclusion: The record is broadly accurate. The authors argue that SGDF balances gradient bias and variance, improves convergence and generalization over traditional momentum methods, and competes with other optimizers. They qualify the Adam extension as architecture-dependent and requiring further analysis, and acknowledge additional computational cost.
record.recipe_differences: Compares several optimizers on CIFAR and ImageNet classification, with different models, tuning choices and reported measures; the study does not reproduce the cited optimizer studies’ full benchmark recipes.
record.method_sensitivity: Results vary by architecture and dataset. The authors report that tuning settings affect results; ImageNet uses β1=0.5, while β1=0.9 can also outperform SGD. CIFAR results use 200 epochs and batch size 128.

fits_no_version.finding: SGDF improves test accuracy over momentum SGD across the six recorded CIFAR conditions.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Filtering SGD's gradient estimate can improve held-out image-classification accuracy relative to momentum SGD.

fits_no_version.finding: On ResNet18/CIFAR-100, AdamW has Hessian trace 0.39 and maximum eigenvalue 0.11, yet the authors report test accuracy about four points below other methods.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Unscaled Hessian curvature can fail to rank optimizer solutions by test accuracy; this does not test magnitude-aware sharpness in V7.

fits_no_version.finding: Filter-Adam improves CIFAR-100 accuracy over vanilla Adam on VGG11 and ResNet34, and ties on DenseNet121 in Table 5.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Replacing Adam's first-moment estimate with a Wiener-filter estimate can improve image-classification accuracy in an architecture-dependent way.

record.problems: CIFAR table reports means and standard deviations for three runs. ImageNet comparisons partly use best-reported results from prior work or PyTorch pretrained models rather than a fully matched experiment. No training accuracy values are tabulated alongside the CIFAR test-accuracy summary.
record.rows_left_out: Optimizer results beyond SGDF, SGD, Adam, AdamW and RAdam in Appendix E, Table 7 were omitted to prioritize the direct comparisons relevant to V4 and remain within 60 rows. ImageNet optimizer comparisons and other tasks were also omitted; some use reported prior results or do not provide matched optimizer evaluations.

untested.parts: Random-label fitting and matched natural-label versus random-label held-out performance.
Width sweeps beyond the interpolation threshold.
Convolutional versus fully connected networks and the contribution of local connectivity.

The learning-rate-and-schedule-only tuning restriction; a controlled limited-versus-broader tuning comparison; language benchmarks; switching Adam to SGD; and a matched intervention isolating decoupled weight decay. Training-performance equivalence cannot be established from the flattened accuracy curves.
Batch-size interventions under fixed epoch budgets and adaptations that remove their penalty.
Dropout interventions, training-set-size dependence, and joint removal of dropout and weight decay.
Magnitude-scaled perturbation tolerance, its association with generalization gaps, and ranking against norm- and margin-based measures.
Influence-based removal of memorized examples and retraining against random-removal controls.

record.verdict_notes: All Table 7 values match the supplied text, but the measure is mean best test accuracy across three runs, with standard deviations, rather than necessarily final-epoch accuracy. CIFAR uses 200 epochs, batch size 128, augmentation and a common decay at epoch 150. SGD uses momentum 0.9. Adaptive-method tuning includes beta1, and AdamW additionally receives a weight-decay search. No causal effect of expanding tuning is isolated. Omitted Table 7 optimizers include important counterexamples, notably AdaBelief outperforming SGD in all six conditions; these omissions are already declared in rows_left_out, so they are not listed as missing or used for verdicts here. ImageNet comparisons also are declared omitted and largely reuse prior results. The flattened training curves do not permit reliable model-specific training-accuracy comparisons.

versions.untested_parts: Random-label memorization and generalization on natural labels.
Language benchmarks, broader tuning, switching from Adam to SGD, and optimizer effects beyond the reported tasks.
Batch-size comparisons under fixed epoch budgets and adaptations to batch size.
Magnitude-aware weight perturbations and comparisons against norm- and margin-based measures.

tranche.reason: Direct optimizer comparisons using held-out image-classification accuracy retain the original comparison method and measure; the broader tuning recipe limits interpretation of the restricted-tuning clause.

statements.correction: CIFAR-10 VGG11: RAdam 90.47±0.34%, momentum SGD 89.83±0.05%. DenseNet121: AdamW 94.61±0.06%, momentum SGD 94.52±0.03%. Expanded searches include adaptive momentum coefficients and AdamW weight decay; no controlled narrow-to-broad tuning intervention or significance test for these differences. Label: limits_scope.
statements.problem: The numerical comparisons and tuning qualifications are accurate, but the challenges label conflicts with V4's explicit allowance for reversals under broader tuning.
